verdict.rationale: Lithic documents dated API versions selected with an `api-version` request header, which lets integrators control when changes reach them. That covers the versioning half of the story. The evidence never states a deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods or how long old versions are supported. The legacy-webhooks-to-Events-API migration guide shows a one-off transition, not a general policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods and support windows for old versions, a changelog or version list, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Choose which dated version of the Lithic API serves your requests, and control when changes reach your integration.
Send the `api-version` request header with the version you want
